question: What claim is being made about transmission when the practice of the soul is said to have been told to the addressed one?
premises: This practice of the soul is indicated.
It has been told to you.
inference: The practice of the soul has now been told to Bhairavī.
uncertainties: The full content of the practice is not repeated in this verse.
plain_english: This practice of the soul has been told to you, and to you, O Bhairavī.
